preferred_rationale: Figure appears verbatim in the PAN description on the West Lothian Council portal ('AI Data Centre Campus with a 250 MW demand utility capacity') and matches all developer material; but whether it is IT load or grid import is not stated - 'demand utility capacity' most likely means grid demand.
notes: Same 250 MW figure repeated on Apatura's consultation site and in Foxglove's December 2025 table.

250 MW BESS paired with the data centre, to be consented separately via a Section 36 application to Scottish Ministers per the PAN description and the developer's project page. No ECU application located as of 2026-07-30.

Developer states a grid connection offer at Harburn substation was 'formally accepted in Q2 2025' via NESO. Offer capacity in MW not stated (presumably up to 250 MW plus BESS); not independently verified against NESO connections data.
